title: Does reconstruction error change the ranking of methods or only their level?
question: When the comparator arm must be reconstructed from a published Kaplan-Meier figure, does the reconstruction error change which method performs best, as it would if it penalized likelihood-based methods more, or does it only shift every method's error?
design: OUT-13's publication and reconstruction model; Kaplan-Meier and Weibull RMST on true and reconstructed data and the digitized curve integrated directly; fine or coarse figures, 6-monthly risk table or none, spread or clustered censoring. 8 cells, 1000 replicates each.
